serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Trello, an Atlassian product, is a visual collaboration tool that creates a shared perspective on any project. With an easy-to-grasp layout of boards, lists, and cards, Trello gives teams a shared workspace for projects of all kinds. Teamwork gets even more productive with automation and integrations with 150+ top work tools. Organize and manage work across your organization in a flexible and rewarding way - Trello is available via web or dedicated apps across desktop and mobile platforms.
